title: UAAP: UST boys sweep Adamson to inch closer to Final 4 berth
summary: University of Santo Tomas stretched its unbeaten run to nine games with a 25-23, 25-22, 25-19 sweep of Adamson University in the UAAP Season 89 boys' volleyball tournament on Sunday.
